maddeler.e:
استحملن (form X)
# اِسْتَحْمَلْنَ (istaḥmalna) /is.taħ.mal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَحْمَلَ (istaḥmala)
# اُسْتُحْمِلْنَ (ustuḥmilna) /us.tuħ.mil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْمَلَ (istaḥmala)
# اِسْتَحْمِلْنَ (istaḥmilna) /is.taħ.mil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْمَلَ (istaḥmala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
